seoTitle: How to Connect Zoho CRM to Shopify for Free
metaDescription: Install the Zoho CRM app on Shopify to manage leads, track sales, and sync customer data automatically between both platforms.
intro: Managing customer relationships separately from your storefront makes it harder to track leads and sales in one place. This guide covers how to install the Zoho CRM app from the Shopify App Store, connect your Zoho account, and configure the integration for automatic data syncing.

steps.heading: Install the Zoho CRM app
steps.body: Search for the Zoho CRM app in the Shopify App Store and add it to your store.

steps.heading: Connect your Zoho account
steps.body: Log into your existing Zoho CRM account through the app to authorize the connection.

steps.heading: Configure integration settings
steps.body: Set up which data, such as customer details or orders, should sync automatically between Shopify and Zoho.

steps.heading: Manage leads and sales in Zoho
steps.body: Use Zoho CRM to track leads generated from your Shopify store and monitor sales activity.

steps.heading: Automate customer workflows
steps.body: Take advantage of Zoho's automation tools to follow up with customers based on their Shopify activity.

faq.question: Is the Zoho CRM app free to install on Shopify?
faq.answer: The app installation itself may be free, though Zoho CRM's own subscription tiers can affect which features are available to you.

faq.question: Will customer data sync automatically after setup?
faq.answer: Yes, once configured, the integration typically syncs customer and order data automatically between the two platforms.

faq.question: Can I use Zoho CRM without connecting it to Shopify?
faq.answer: Yes, Zoho CRM works as a standalone tool, but connecting it to Shopify adds the benefit of automatic customer and sales data syncing.

faq.question: Does this integration help with marketing automation?
faq.answer: Yes, having Shopify data in Zoho CRM lets you build more targeted follow-ups and workflows based on customer purchase behavior.
